description: WHEN: to run one ERP MCP tool on ONE Dynamics 365 F&O instance, as the signed-in user (their own F&O roles and legal entities apply). Get the tool name and argument schema from erp_list_tools first. On protected instances (PROD) any tool that is not flagged read-only needs confirm=true, and you must only set it after the user explicitly approved the exact action. On a readOnly instance every tool that can change data is refused and confirm does not override it. To compare two instances, call erp_call once per instance with the same read-only tool and diff the results.

arguments.description: JSON object with the tool arguments, as a string. Omit or "{}" when none.

confirm.description: Required true to run a non read-only tool on a protected instance.

name: erp_call
